ids.description: symbolic name -> fixed canonical lowercase UUID; the lowest UUID of a component is its survivor

harness.description: v8 only: opClock, trust (signer names), signatureValid, preserved{work:bool}, assetBytes{digest:desc}, clockSubstitution (text)

incoming.description: manifest fragment spec, built by _v8-builder.json; the string "<absent>" for a key means the key is physically omitted

seq.description: contiguous per writer across initial+ops; never reused within a universe

stamp.description: [logicalCounter, writerIncarnation, seq]; counter strictly above the writer's previous counter and above the counter of every op named below

observed.description: named evidence: gen, deletions, basis, epochs, base, sources, adds, supersedes; every value that is an op id is a semantic prerequisite

requires.description: cross-writer prerequisites only; same-writer order is implicit and not repeated

initial.description: either {createHistory:[op...]} (valid ops applied before the universe) or {checkpoint:{cut, facts}}

restarts.description: {name, order, restartAfter:'every'|[index]}: kill and reload from durable state

checkpoints.description: {name, cutAfter[], thenOrder[]}: install a checkpoint at the cut, then deliver thenOrder

expected.description: identical for every complete schedule; state = normalized projection (works, memberships, annotations, assets, settings, pronunciations, witnesses); diagnostics derived from final facts and sorted
